title: Road detours
notes: Keep one adult at each table; the youngest adult can record road names while children choose and replay. First routes: K-1 Problems 1-2, three/four-step tree journeys, then four-step ring home trips; Grades 2-3 Problems 1-4; Grades 4-5 Problems 1-4. Use one ordered card for each actual road traversal; remove only out-and-back pairs and replay the rest. K-1 Problems 3-7 remain for a later visit or when ready. On return, Grades 2-3 and 4-5 take the two-ring order problems (P5-6); for Grades 4-5 these find zero-net-count trips that cannot disappear. The actual tile/mat/pawn procedure remains physically untested.
